notes: Propane (LP) Spirit II E-310, three burners: the part numbers come from the 2017 US/CA/MX schematic for the black (Blk) version, and some rows are tagged '18 or '19. The owner's manual calls the cooking grates porcelain-enameled cast iron and the burners heavy-duty stainless steel (p.5), and says the regulator has a flow-limiting device and a Type 1 (CGA 810) tank connection (p.8).

gaps: No burner rating is claimed: the manual's rating box is in kJ/h and does not say whether it is per burner or total.
Propane and gas_cylinder are not claimed; the tank is not part of the grill.
The schematic gives no quantities, so qty is kept only on kit, set and assembly rows (one row = one kit or assembly) and removed from the other rows.
The schematic shows the LP manifold assembly (67033) but not the control valves, so valve_solenoid carries the manifold row only.
The grate, burner and regulator facts from the manual are in the notes, not the part rows, because the part numbers come from a different document.
The igniter battery's type and voltage are not claimed; the manual (p.16) names only the battery that powers the ignition module.

Filing as tube_frame (burner tube kit, crossover tube), bearing (wheel), rod_shaft (axle), battery_primary (igniter battery), sensor_misc (tank scale) and sheet_metal (flavorizer bars, heat deflector, control panel, cookbox) is the researcher's classification; each spec names the part.
SS in the schematic (heat deflector, control panel) is kept as printed.
Years: the schematic title says 2017 and some rows carry '18 and '19 tags; no production span is stated.
method: Weber LP Owner's Manual 59502 (revision 08/06/23, 60 pages, covers E-210, S-210, E-310 and S-310), PDF from digital-assets.weber.com, read as text; PDF page numbers equal the printed ones.
Weber parts schematic 45010001, 'Spirit II E-310 LP Blk (2017) (US/CA/MX)', schematics.weber.com print page; fetched three times and every part number compared with its part name digit by digit.
